ISSUE_KIND: pothole
ISSUE: Pothole filled with water on Baltimore Avenue (US 1)
DETAILS: The photo shows a large, deep pothole in an asphalt roadway, filled with dark water. The surrounding pavement is cracked and degraded.
ORGANIZATION: Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration
DEPARTMENT: District 3 Office
WHY: Baltimore Avenue at this location is US 1, a state-maintained highway. The Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration (MDOT SHA) manages the maintenance, including pothole repairs, for all numbered US and state routes in Maryland, including this stretch through College Park.
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "Typically, traffic signals at intersections on State roads are maintained by the State."
